svg.title: Fig. 2, Investor portal
svg.desc: Figure 2, Investor portal, investment firm, exploded view. 1, Interface: Investor and admin screens for portfolios, holdings, valuations and documents, built in Next.js. 2, API: tRPC procedures, with Better Auth for sign-in. 3, Transactions: Validation and every write commit together, or not at all. 4, Data: PostgreSQL with Prisma, and documents in AWS S3. Distribution path: Distribution recorded, then Checked against current value, then Holdings, history and totals updated, then ROI and total return recalculated, then Monthly valuation history rebuilt. Commits: 66 (October to December 2025). Schema migrations: 18 (versioned SQL). TypeScript files: 275 (in the application). Computed 2026-10-10 at commit f091c14.
